summary: Iteration 3 pre-launch feature testing. Backend: 45/46 pass (1 xfailed = REAL bug). Frontend end-to-end verified for all 7 new features. CRITICAL BUG: POST /api/leads/bulk/research is completely broken — route ordering collision with POST /api/leads/{lead_id}/research (declared earlier at line 249) captures 'bulk' as lead_id → returns 404 'Lead not found'. Reproduced via curl. All other bulk endpoints (/assign, /campaign, /delete) work because they have no matching /leads/{lead_id}/* counterpart. Every other feature verified: Import Dedup returns {inserted, skipped} correctly for both /leads/import and /leads/import-csv on re-upload; Notes save + appear in timeline (data-testid timeline-item); Website Re-check works for both real (example.com→Good) and no-website (returns message) paths; One-Click Outreach: wa.me link built correctly (wa.me/919876543210?text=<387-char AI text>, target=_blank, no auto-send) for phone-having leads, mailto: link built with ?subject=&body=, 'No phone on record' note shown for lead without phone; Saved Searches CRUD works from UI (Save button, chip appears, delete via X); Dashboard shows OVERDUE badge (red) and 'Upcoming (7 days)' list; Bulk Actions frontend: selecting 2 checkboxes shows bulk-bar with '2 selected' + all 4 buttons (assign/campaign/research/delete), select-all works, delete confirms via window.confirm dialog. No console errors on any page.

critical.issue: Route-ordering collision: POST /api/leads/{lead_id}/research (declared at server.py:249) captures /leads/bulk/research with lead_id='bulk' → HTTPException(404, 'Lead not found'). Bulk Research feature is 100% dead in production. Frontend clicks the button, POST fires, backend returns 404, frontend shows generic 'Failed' toast. Fix: move POST /leads/bulk/research (and the entire /leads/bulk/* group) ABOVE the /leads/{lead_id}/* routes in server.py, OR rename to a non-colliding path (e.g. /leads/batch/research). This is the SAME class of bug as iteration 1's export-csv 404.

integration_issues.flow: Bulk Research (All Leads → check rows → Research)
integration_issues.issue: Backend returns 404 (see backend critical bug above). Button visible + clickable but the operation always fails. Frontend UI is correct, ONLY the backend route needs to be fixed.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix route ordering in /app/backend/server.py — declare POST /leads/bulk/research (and any future /leads/bulk/* endpoints) BEFORE POST /leads/{lead_id}/research. Simplest fix: physically move the whole '# ===== BULK ACTIONS =====' block (lines ~387-440) above the '# ===== AI: RESEARCH / SCORE / OUTREACH =====' block (line 248). Alternatively rename /leads/bulk/research to /leads/batch/research.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:249 & 414 — FastAPI matches routes in declaration order. Any specific sub-path under /leads/ that shares a suffix with the parameterized /leads/{lead_id}/* pattern MUST be declared above it. Same class of bug as iteration 1's export-csv 404. Consider adding a lint/CI check or a comment header explaining this.

server.py `research` endpoint (line 249) doesn't have an explicit request timeout budget — if a prospect's website is very slow, up to ~12s of blocking (already limited by httpx.Timeout in web_research.py). Preview ingress cuts at ~100s, so this is currently safe. Just flagging for scale.

server.py bulk_research (line 414) silently swallows exceptions per-lead — good for robustness, but the caller can't see WHICH leads failed. Consider returning `researched, requested, failed_ids` to give the UI a better toast.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — cosmetic warning only, but replace with FastAPI lifespan handlers before the next major FastAPI upgrade.
AllLeads.jsx uses window.confirm() for delete/research — works fine but a shadcn AlertDialog would be more consistent with the design system.

LeadWorkspace.jsx line 314 — Follow-up <input type="date"> uses browser-native date picker; per code review guidelines a shadcn calendar component would be more consistent (already flagged in previous iterations, low priority).

rca of the issue: POST /api/leads/bulk/research is captured by POST /api/leads/{lead_id}/research because in server.py the parameterized route (line 249) is registered BEFORE the specific /leads/bulk/research route (line 414). FastAPI matches routes in declaration order — so 'bulk' becomes lead_id='bulk', db.leads.find_one({id:'bulk'}) returns None, endpoint raises HTTPException(404, 'Lead not found'). Reproduction: curl -X POST $BASE/api/leads/bulk/research -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"lead_ids":["any"]}' → {"detail":"Lead not found"} 404. Fix: move the entire BULK ACTIONS section (lines ~387-440) BEFORE the AI: RESEARCH section (line 248), OR rename the path to /leads/batch/research (which doesn't collide). Note: /leads/bulk/assign, /leads/bulk/campaign, /leads/bulk/delete accidentally work today only because /leads/{lead_id}/assign, /leads/{lead_id}/campaign, /leads/{lead_id}/delete don't exist as POST routes — but the same class of latent bug will re-appear the moment any lead-specific sub-route with matching suffix is added.
